content.comment_body: Good afternoon, I need help to receive this data bit over the network, but it never arrives. I've already programmed the input and output network blocks. Has anyone else experienced this?

Hello [user_name], welcome to the community! Please try to ask your question in English, since this is an international community and we focus on a single language. Posting in English will help you get more responses. Here is a translation of your question. Regards, [user_name]
Have you enabled S7 access? Go to File > Properties > Offline Settings > General.

I've enabled it on both devices, but without success. I changed to Modbus communication and still can't read the bit. Can you explain how to read this bit using Modbus? When both devices are in the same project tree, they communicate without issue. The problem is in the field where they are in separate projects, so I can't keep them in the same network project tree.
This is how it looks after I switched to Modbus.
This is how it looks after I switched to Modbus.
English please, if you want answers...

Hello [user_name], please use English since we are an international community, and English is the main language here. If you want a quick answer, posting in English is the best way. Here are translations of your posts. Regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: The user faced issues receiving a data bit from a remote [product_name] over the network using both S7 and Modbus protocols. Communication works when both devices are part of the same project tree but fails in field deployments where projects are separated. This highlights confusion in configuring distributed projects and indicates a lack of clear guidance or documentation for network setups across distinct projects.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects reliable data transmission between two [product_name] units deployed in separate projects, with straightforward configuration using either S7 or Modbus protocols to ensure seamless bit exchange regardless of project structure.
pain_keywords: unclear setup instructions for separate projects
